tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i kha skong las byang yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i las byang yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bla sgrub bzhi'i dbang lung rdzogs rim gyi rim pa legs par mnos shing rgyun khyer rgyas bsdus gang rung la yi dam chag med du byed pa dag gis/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu/ bco lnga/ nyer lnga/ gnam gang sogs dus dge ba rnams sam/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dus mchod sogs kyi tshe maṇḍal mchod cing tshogs kyi 'khor lo bgyi bar/ gnas dben par bla sgrub bzhi yi bris sku'i mdun du maṇḍal dri bzang gis sbags pa'i dbus su 'bru sman rin po che'i tshom bu che ba gcig bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i nang mchod/ chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga/ tshogs rdzas rnams bshams/ rdor dril sogs nyer mkho 'du byas/ stan bde bar 'khod nas skyabs sems tshangs gnas sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la snying khar bzung zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod/ dril bu aḥdang dril bu las skyes pa'i yum rdo rje snyems ma de yongs su gyur pa las dril bur gyur/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la kha nang du phyogs pa dkur bzhag /slar rdo rje sngar ltar dang dril bu nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du lce bskyod cing sgra 'byin par/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā wa/ badzra satwa hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥswā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir mū bi ra shu ma rnams las dri chen dri chu rakta byang sems klad pa rnams oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥs mtshan pa'i dbus dang*/ mtshams bzhir na da go ha ku las mi rta ba lang glang chen khyi'i sha rnams bāṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan pa'i kha gcod zla ba nya gang bar g.yas skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dkar po dang*/ g.yon skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥdamar pos bskor ba'i dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ brtsegs mar gnas pa/ rang gi sna bug gi rlung hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bus pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas khol ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad sbyangs/ yig gsum dbyangs gsal las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod/ byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa bsdus pa yig 'bru la thim ma thag /yig 'bru zla ba dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rākṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ dbang po gshin rje chu yi lha// gnod sbyin me lha rlung gi bdag /dbang ldan nyi zla lto 'phye dang*// lha klu lha min srin po dang*// 'byung po yi dwags sha za'i tshogs// smyo byed rjed byed mkha' 'gro dang*| |ma mo la sogs gdon gyi tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces rol mo dang bcas gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las dung chen gyi snod rnams su// mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad dngos 'byor yid sprul ma tshang ba med pa rnams ngo bo chos nyid/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa 'dod yon/ byed las rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad dgyes pa skyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dang*/ āḥhūm̐ thog mthar sbyar la/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad sbyar ba'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// gsum brjod/ bdag bskyed ni/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur gyi bar rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa ltar nyams su blang*/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/

g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs/ yang rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa ma thub tshe/ rgyun khyer chung ba byas kyang rung tsam yin no// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ mdun gyi maṇḍal dngos po dang dngos min gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba stong pa chen por 'byams klas pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ e las chos 'byung gi dbus su rlung me sa chu ri rab kyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i lte bar/ bhrūṃ las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rgyan la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang phyogs kyi mdog can gyi phyi rol du sna tshogs padma dang rdo rje'i ra ba'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ padma/ rgya gram gyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du zhes pa nas/ thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa til gyi mar me lta bur gsal bar gyur par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa kho na ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa rnams dor/ de ltar gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkha'i cha la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang*/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la bden pa gnyis kyi chos dkon mchog gis bskor ba dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ rtag par brtse dang*/ mthu chen thob la sogs pa byang sems theg chen 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/

bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho gsang sngags gsar rnying gi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams dang*/ 'og gi cha la gdan khri'i thad du dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de thams cad nam mkha' la char sprin stug po 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi gnas rnams kyi yi ge las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur/ ces 'don pa spos la rgyun 'khyer ltar bya'o// de nas mchod pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa las/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ zhing khams rgya mtsho dpag med na// dngos 'byor yid las byung ba yi// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ */oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du shapada'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ 'dod yon lnga ni/ spyan gyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// gzugs kyi rdo rje me long 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// gzugs snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra rū pa badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ snyan gyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// sgra yi rdo rje pi waṃ 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// sgrar snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra shapad badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ shangs kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// dri yi rdo rje dung chos 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// drir snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig

/oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra gandhe badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ljags kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// ro yi rdo rje zhal zas 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// ror snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ra sa badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sku yi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// reg bya'i rdo rje na bza' 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// reg snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra sparshe badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thugs kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i// chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung 'dzin// dpag yas nam mkha' bkang ste dbul// chos snang 'khrul ba dag gyur cig /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra dharma dhā tu badzra pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal srid bdun ni/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// 'khor lo rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// chos kyi 'khor sgyur thob par shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// nor bu rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul| |mkhyen brtse'i 'byor pa thob par shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ma ṇi ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// btsun mo rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra st+rī ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// blon po rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo tsa na ka ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// glang po rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// thams cad mkhyen cing bgrod par shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra hasti ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// rta mchog rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra tuṅga a shwa ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su// dmag dpon rin chen ji snyed pa// 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal bar shog /oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra se na ṭhakku ra ratna pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ bde sogs bdag po lha min gyi// g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis rtags// gdugs la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad| |lha tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul// oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra aṣṭa liṅga maṅga la pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

rdzas brgyad ni/ sngon tshe bde gshegs thub pa'i dbang po la// lha dbang la sogs 'byor tshogs ldan rnams kyis// me long la sogs rdzas brgyad phul ba ltar// dad pas deng 'dir 'bul lo bkra shis stsol// oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra aṣṭa dra bya maṅga la pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i nor 'dzin maṇḍal la// ri rab gling dang gling phran tshom bur bkram// sna tshogs 'dod yon du mas nyer mdzes pa// dbul gyis bzhes nas dngos grub deng 'dir stsol// oṃ badzra mū la pa raṃ pa ra gu ru buddha dharma saṅgha de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra maṇḍal pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa la sogs pa mchod pa'i rigs gang shes 'bul lo// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ hoḥ mtshan dang ldan pa'i dung chen po// 'khor yug yangs pa'i snod nang du// sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga// rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong*// 'chi med pañtsa a mṛ ta// ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsi 'di// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// shes rab bzang po'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// dzñā na siddhi'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// chos kyi blo gros zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// rin chen dpal gyi zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// sher phyin yum gyi zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// byang sems dge 'dun zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par gsol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du 'bul// dgyes par bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi// yul lha gzhi bdag zhal du 'bul// dgyes par bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi// zhes nang mchod thigs gtor 'bul/

gtor mar bdud rtsis bran la/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs rjes/ rnam lnga 'dod kor dang bcas| oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gu ru sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ slar rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum yangs pa'i bhandha ru// bcud kyi gtor ma rgya cher ldan// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho nyer gtams pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// rin chen gtor gzhong yangs pa ru// 'bru sman rin chen gtor mar bshams// sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar ldan pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// sgyu lus 'byung 'dus gzhong pa ru// don snod bcud kyi gtor chen bshams// khu khrag rkang mar bdud rtsir bcas// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// sems nyid dag pa'i bhandha ru// gang shar snang stong gtor mar bshams// 'gyu dran rig grol bdud rtsis bran// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// zhes dang*/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pra pā da wā di mū la gu ru shākya mu ni badzra dhṛka ྄su kha ratna shrī pa raṃ pa ra sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ kā ma de wa bī ra ḍā ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun gyis yi dam dang*/ oṃ dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum gyis chos skyong la gtor ma dbul lo// gsum pa gsang mchod ni| sku yi phyag rgya rol pa ni// dkar mo 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can// snyoms 'jug bde ba rā ga ya// 'bul gyis lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// karma mu dra tsakra dha ra a nu rā ga ya/ gsung gi phyag rgya rol pa ni// dmar mo padma'i phyag rgya can// snyoms 'jug bde ba rā ga ya// 'bul gyis lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// karma mu dra padma dha ra a nu rā ga ya/ thugs kyi phyag rgya rol pa ni// mthing nag rdo rje'i phyag rgya can// snyoms 'jug bde ba rā ga ya// 'bul gyis lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// karma mu dra badzra dha ra a nu rā ga ya/

yon tan phyag rgya rol pa ni// ser mo rin chen phyag rgya can// snyoms 'jug bde ba rā ga ya// 'bul gyis lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// karma mu dra ratna dha ra a nu rā ga ya/ phrin las phyag rgya rol pa ni// ljang mo rgya gram phyag rgya can// snyoms 'jug bde ba rā ga ya// 'bul gyis lhan skyes dngos grub stsol// karma mu dra bi shwa dha ra a nu rā ga ya/ zhes 'bul/ lha rnams rig ma dang snyoms 'jug gi bde bas tshim par bsam mo/ bzhi pa de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ rang sems gdod nas spros dang bral// khams gsum sems can sangs rgyas dngos// nga dang gzhan gyi 'khrul rtsa bral// ma rig 'od gsal ye shes ngang*// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang bden pas stong*// rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid can// dkyil 'khor lha rnams rang sems kyi// cho 'phrul snang ngor gdod nas grub// mchod pa 'dod yon rol pa'i rtsal// gcig las du ma du ma'ang gcig /gnyis med mnyam pa'i rang bzhin ngang*// mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i rdzas// lha dang sgrub po la sogs pa// 'khor gsum gdod nas yongs su dag /gzhi med rtsa bral bde ba che// ma skyes mi 'gag a la la// mi gnas mi dmigs e ma hoḥ /chos nyid mnyam yangs mchod pa 'di// gdod nas grub pa ngo mtshar che// de ring mtshan 'dzin mchod pa spangs// mtshan med mnyam rol mnyam pa nyid// 'bul du ma mchis dbul ba'i mchog /bzhes su ma mchis bzhes dang bral// dngos grub gdod nas rnam par dag /de ring rang rig chos skur rtogs// mtshan 'dzin bgegs rnams rang sar zhi// ma 'bad 'dod yon ngang gis grub| |dngos grub rnam gnyis ya mtshan che// ma hā mu dra/ zhes dbul/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ rje thams cad sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// zhes sho lo ka gcig dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// dam pa khyod ni gzod nas grol// mya ngan 'das la rab zhugs pa// dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol yang*// sems can don phyir 'khor bar 'jug

/'dam gyi padma ltar dag pa// dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod ni gdod nas sangs rgyas mod// rmongs pa'i sems can 'khrul ba'i ngor// phal pa'i gzugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rdo rje sems// slob dpon tshul du 'byung gsungs pa// dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs thub pas nga nyid ni// mi yul bod kyi grong khyer du// mi dang 'dra bar snang gsungs pa// dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mtshan 'dzin spros pa kun spangs kyang*// spros pa du ma'i snang ba ston// ji ltar chu zla'i zlos gar bzhin// dam pa khyod ni gzod nas grol// gdod nas mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten rgyan kun khyod kyis spangs// dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra ba// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sha rus dngos por 'dzin pa spangs// med pa stong pa'ang rnam par spangs// nam mkha' la ni glog lta bu// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gis lung du ston pa dang*// mi ston pa sogs sgra yi gnas// rnam pa thams cad rab spangs pa/ bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems can rnams kyi rna ba ru// brag cha'i sgra ltar khyab mdzad cing*// gang gi grag stong gzhom med sgra// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes dang shes bya'i dngos po rnams// me long gzugs ltar rab rtogs pas// gsal la rtog pa mi mnga' ba// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yod med rtag chad mtha' dang bral// yan lag bdun ldan chos kyi sku// mkha' ltar kun khyab gzod ma'i mgon// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang zhig yid bzhin nor bu ltar// gsol ba btab na dgos dgu stsol// rtog med phyogs lhung rnam spangs pa// yon tan mnga' bdag khyod la bstod// gcig dang du ma'i mtha' bral zhing*// nyi ma'i 'od ltar mkha' khyab kyi// 'gro la thar lam ston mdzad pa'i// phrin las zla med khyod phyag 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa sogs brjod/

bla sgrub bzhi'i bzlas pa ci nus bzla/ slar rigs rnams kun gyi dbang phyug ye shes sku// sogs kyis gsol ba btab cing*/ bdag 'jug blang ba ni/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi mdun du 'don cha dang mtshungs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams ye shes kyi rang snang las grub par dmigs/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe bla ma'i thugs ka nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dngos 'dra ba spros pas dbang gi bya ba mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad par bsams nas/ maṇḍal dbul/ dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba 'debs pa nas bzung*/ sku bzhi thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs par byas par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar dbang bzhi rdzogs kyi bdag 'jug rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa'i skabs ltar blang*/ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang bzhi dang cha 'dra ba bla ma mchod pa rnams su mdzad pa ye shes grub pa'i lung gi dgongs pa ltar dpyis phyin pa yin mod/ 'on kyang dbang bzhi rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di lam dus su nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras dus su sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid yan lag bdun ldan gyi chos skur sangs rgyas nas/ de'i snang brnyan longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rten 'brel rmad du byung ba yin/ rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs pa// sogs tshul gsum sgron me'i lung ltar ches cher 'phags pa yin no// de nas tshogs kyi dga' ston bya ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud rten gyi drung phul la/ hūm̐ */ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan chos sku rdo rje 'chang*| |rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas// longs sku bde ba'i rdo rje mchog /rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog nas// sprul sku sangs rgyas shākya thub// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas| |ngo bo nyid sku ratna shrī// rang snang mos pa'i pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod zhabs// gar bzhugs dag pa'i zhing khams nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// lhun grub ye shes mkha' klong nas// yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gnas yul dag pa'i pho brang nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs// dur khrod 'jigs rung zhing khams nas| |bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnal 'byor tshogs khang pho brang 'dir// mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs bskyed dam dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dgyes bzhugs bdag phyag 'tshal// 'don yon longs spyod tshogs kyi rdzas// rdo rje mchog gi dngos po 'di// gtsang dme gnyis 'dzin rnams spangs pa// dpal gyi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul// a la la ste dgyes par rol// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// 'dod yon longs spyod dam pa 'di// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs 'di dag

/tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bdag 'bul na// dgyes par rol te bzhes nas kyang*// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs// rnam gsum sdig sgrib myur dag cing*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob gsol// de ma thob gyi bar du yang*// gnas ngan len spangs rnal 'byor mchog /thob cing chos ldan grogs dang bcas| |dam pas rjes bzung lam bstan nas// dam chos spyod la gegs med shog /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bsdu bzhis mos pa dbang du bsdu// bstan gnod dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod// gong gi sngags la ga ṇa tsakra btags pas dbul/ sgrub pos longs spyad/ rdo rje'i glu ni/ e ma hoḥthabs dang shes rab tshogs// e ma hoḥstong nyid snying rje mchog /e ma hoḥsnang srid gdod nas dag /e ma hoḥzung 'jug bde ba che// gzhi ni rnam dag ka nas dag /lam ni rnam dag bskyed dang rdzogs// 'bras bu rnam dag yan lag bdun// sgrub po rnam dag a la la// ngo mtshar gcig las du mar snang*// snang ba ma 'gag chu zla bzhin// bzhin ras me long nang lta bur// bu gcig rang ngo rang gis mthong*| |thabs dang shes rab rnam rol cing*// rdo rje padma zung du 'jug /bde dang stong pa nyi ma dang*// zer bzhin lhan skyes ngang du grol// zhes brjod/ lhag ma bsdus par/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ bde gshegs lhag ma'i longs spyod 'di// rnam par dag pa'i pha 'bab ste// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas// 'dod yon dam rdzas 'bar ba 'di// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang*// srung ma dam can phyogs skyong sogs// lhag ma'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bzhin du// dam ldan sgrub po'i sdong grogs mdzod| |dam med slob ma'i gshed ma mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma mdzod// 'khor srung rkyen ngan zlog par mdzod// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// utstshiṣṭa ba lingta ga ṇa tsakra khā hi khā hi/

zhes dor/ mjug ni/ dkyil 'khor pa la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar byas nas/ cho ga chad lhag byung ba dang*// sogs sho lo ka dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ| khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// sogs sho lo ka dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying khar thim par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ gi sngags brjod cing*/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes shing*/ mthar 'gag pa med pa'i ngo bo la mnyam par bzhag /shis brjod skabs sbyar dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas rgyas gdab par bya'o// smras pa/ sngon byon rdo rje 'dzin rnams 'gran zla bral// 'on kyang dag pa'i zhing gzhan gshegs zin mod// dus mthar thug tshe rdo rje theg pa'i lam// rgyas dang bsdus dang bar ma'i sbyor ba rnams// dbang po dang 'tsham don tshang 'khrul med pa// cig car 'chad la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba// kho bo'ang rdo rje'i slob dpon gdan 'dzom gyi// byug ris tha mar 'dug la the tshom bral// rnyed bkur 'khor 'bangs mgu byed gnas skabs su// bzang por brdzus pa'i byi la'i rnam thar can// rang bzo'i lam du blun po 'ga' bkris nas// dga' ba sgom pa'i slob dpon 'ga' soms shig /'di brtsams pa la 'khrul ba'i dri// mchis na rgyal ba'i mdun du bshags// dge ba gang mchis sems can rnams// rdzogs byang kho na 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa'ang lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cha lag tu/ mchod pa'i las byang zhig dgos zhes mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ skyu ra'i gdung las dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhes ming tsam 'dzin pas lhag bsam dkar po'i 'dun pa nye bar bzhag nas/ me glang nag pa can gyi phyogs phyi ma'i rdzogs pa dang po la/
'bri dam pa chos phyug klung gi gdan sa chen por 'bad pas sbyar ba/ ye ge pa ni ma dhya kīrti ind+ra'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
